name: Inshoku no Mahou Shoujo Tentacle!
original_name: 淫触の魔法少女テンタクル！
source:
Novice idol Azusa one day found a strange creature in front of her home that could speak in human language. It called itself "Nurupon".
Nurupon requested (forced?) Azusa to change into a magical girl so it could wriggle its tentacles into her womb.
Azusa resisted but was transformed... into Lust Limbs Magical Girl Tentacle, defender of her last shred of chastity!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ055325.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
新人偶像永野梓某天在家门口发现一只会说人话的奇怪生物。它自称“纽噜蓬”。
纽噜蓬要求（或者说强迫？）梓变身成魔法少女，好让自己的触手钻进她的子宫。
梓奋力反抗，却还是完成了变身……成为守护最后一丝贞操的淫触魔法少女“触手”！
